notes.subject: ושפי
notes.rationale: Rare word from bareness: 'his once-hidden bones are laid bare' (KJV 'stick out') vs 'corrode' (JPS) vs 'are high' (YLT).

notes.subject: ושפי
notes.rationale: Form occurs only here in the Tanakh; root שפה means bareness, a bare hill.

notes.subject: מראי / ראו
notes.rationale: Root ראה (see) used twice — flesh unseen, bones not seen — chiasm lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Mit bilong em i pinis olgeta, ol i no inap lukim ⟨em⟩; na ol bun bilong em, we bipo ol i no lukim, ol i kamap bare olgeta.
